test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - GA (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following does NOT come under Directive Principles of State Policy?

options.text: Promotion of the Welfare of the People

solution:
The correct answer is __**Promotion of Indian Local Languages**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While the promotion of languages can be seen as a cultural goal, it is not explicitly mentioned as a Directive Principle in the Constitution of India.
 
• Instead, the Constitution recognizes the importance of languages and provides for the protection of the linguistic rights of minorities.
 
• 
 
**Hence **Promotion of Indian Local Languages is ** NOT** come under the Directive Principles of State Policy.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Promotion of the Welfare of the People:
 
 
• This principle emphasizes the government's duty to work towards the overall welfare and well-being of its citizens.
 
• It is a fundamental aspect of the Directive Principles, aiming for social and economic justice.
 
 
 
• **Uniform Civil Code**:
 
 
• The Uniform Civil Code (UCC) is a Directive Principle aimed at ensuring all citizens of India are treated equally under the same set of secular civil laws, regardless of their religion.
 
• It promotes gender equality and social justice.
 
 
 
• **Promotion of Cottage Industries**:
 
 
• This principle encourages the development of small-scale and cottage industries to boost local economies, provide employment, and promote self-reliance
 
• . It is included in the Directive Principles to enhance the livelihood of rural populations.
